description: This file contains utility functions for parsing durations expressed in different formats (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months), computing the last day of a month, and determining standardized reset times based on various durations. It includes internal helper functions for parsing strings, timezone adjustments, and handling various reset interval calculations.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str] _extract_from_regex(duration: str)
methods.description: Extracts the numeric value and unit from a duration string using regex.

methods.name: get_last_day_of_month(year, month)
methods.description: Calculates the last day of a given month in a specific year.

methods.name: int duration_in_seconds(duration: str)
methods.description: Converts a duration string into the total number of seconds it represents.

methods.name: datetime get_next_standardized_reset_time( duration: str, current_time: datetime, timezone_str: str = "UTC" )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time aligned to predictable intervals based on a duration string.
